solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Prickly, admitting that hurt in tender way

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so one word takes the other inside it

parts.note: a prickly feeling is a tingly one
OUCH is what one says when something has hurt

explanation.surface: Someone thin-skinned and defensive about a past wound, behaving tenderly all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prickly' tempts as touchy, which seems to start the answer; it is really the outer word, with a cry of pain held inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done touchingly moves the feelings, which is acting in a tender, affecting manner.

clue.text: Picked up neckwear from Asian country

indicators.note: picking something up by ear means hearing it, so the word is said aloud

parts.note: a tie is worn round the neck

explanation.surface: A souvenir necktie bought on holiday in Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Thailand's own name and its demonym, but THAI here stands as a word linked to that Asian nation in crossword use.

clue.text: Greek character aloft on storage cylinder initially nervy

parts.note: aloft means up high
a silo is a tall cylindrical store for grain

indicators.note: initially means the opening letter of the word nervy is taken

explanation.surface: A jittery Greek figure perched high on top of a grain silo.
explanation.definitionFit: Upsilon is the twentieth letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in that script.

clue.text: Member entering house is welcomed by people's agreement

indicators.note: entering means going into, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body

indicators.note: being welcomed by means being taken in, so the word is goes inside

parts.note: a nation is a people

explanation.surface: A politician entering the House is greeted by the nation's consensus.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Member' reads as an MP in this political surface, but here it is a limb.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmonisation is bringing things into accord, so it is a form of agreement or concord.

clue.text: Elbows close to crumbling in sculptures, say

indicators.note: in means the letter is placed inside the other word

parts.note: nudes are figures, sculptures being one example, hence 'say'

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so the final letter of crumbling

explanation.surface: Elbows on crumbling statues, close to breaking off.
explanation.definitionFit: To nudge someone is to prod them with the elbow, so elbows as a verb means nudges.

clue.text: Tough moulded layer encasing article

indicators.note: encasing means wrapped around, so one piece holds another
moulded means shaped anew, so these letters are reworked

parts.note: THE is the definite article

explanation.surface: A sturdy moulded coating wrapped round some object.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moulded' rearranges the fodder into LEARY, which then goes round the definite article.
explanation.definitionFit: Leathery describes something hard and chewy like hide, which is tough.

clue.text: Keen to drop second musical instrument

indicators.note: to drop something is to let it go, so the letter is removed

parts.note: a keen blade is a sharp one

explanation.surface: An eager musician ready to give up a second instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A harp is a stringed instrument plucked by hand, one example of a musical instrument.

clue.text: Totally exposed magic star — note upset

indicators.note: each word is stripped of its outer covering, leaving all but its ends

parts.note: TE is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A magician's star performer is left upset after being totally exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: Both words lose their outer letters to give AGI and TA; 'upset' is the definition, not a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: To agitate someone is to disturb or trouble them, a verb synonym of upset.

clue.text: Gang involved in media bias

indicators.note: being involved in something means being caught up within it, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: the press is the news media
a posse is a gang or band

explanation.surface: A clique embedded in the news media shows partiality.
explanation.definitionFit: To prepossess is to influence someone in advance, to prejudice or bias them.

clue.text: Certain idiot with wine on uniform

indicators.note: in an across answer, one piece on another means it follows it

parts.note: an ass is a fool
U is uniform in the NATO alphabet
red is red wine

explanation.surface: A sure-of-himself fool who spilt wine on his uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: Assured means confident or sure, the same as certain in the sense of convinced.

clue.text: Attribute of daisies evenly covering bed

indicators.note: covering means wrapped around, so the picked letters surround the other piece
evenly means the second, fourth and sixth letters of daisies are taken

parts.note: a crib is a child's bed

explanation.surface: A quality of daisies spreading over a flower bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attribute' is a verb here, not the noun it seems.
explanation.definitionFit: To ascribe something is to credit it to a source, which is to attribute it.

clue.text: Major vessel I move quickly in Troy with race at sea

indicators.note: in means these letters sit inside the shuffled ones
at sea means confused and all over the place, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: to dart is to move quickly

explanation.surface: A great ship darting through the waters off Troy in a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at sea' scrambles TROY and RACE; I and DART go into the mix to fill out the two words.
explanation.definitionFit: The carotid artery carries blood to the head, one of the body's main blood vessels.

clue.text: Type of voice to irritate that woman completely

parts.note: alto is a singing voice
to get someone is to annoy them
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A singer whose kind of voice thoroughly annoys a particular woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Altogether means wholly or entirely, an adverb synonym of completely.

clue.text: Fuss from commercial operation's leader

parts.note: an ad is a commercial

indicators.note: a leader comes first, so the opening letter of operation's is taken

explanation.surface: A boss of an advertising firm kicking up a fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: Ado means bother or commotion, a synonym of fuss as in 'much ado about nothing'.

clue.text: Dashing prince playing with pugs

indicators.note: playing about suggests the letters are moved freely

explanation.surface: A handsome royal frolicking with his pet dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dashing' seems to mean stylish, but it is the verb sense of ruining hopes.
explanation.definitionFit: To scupper a plan is to wreck it, just as dashing hopes is destroying them.

clue.text: Open container exhausted

parts.note: a can is a container
did, as in 'did in' or 'did for', means wore out or used up

explanation.surface: An empty container left open.
explanation.definitionFit: A candid person is frank and honest, open about things.

clue.text: Relations extremely bitter with the rest

indicators.note: extremely means the letters at each extreme of bitter, its first and last

parts.note: the others are the rest

explanation.surface: Family members who resent everyone else bitterly.
explanation.definitionFit: Brothers are male siblings, so they are family relations.

clue.text: Exercise class starts to create tough test for muscle

parts.note: PE is physical education, a school exercise class

indicators.note: starts means the first letters of create and tough are taken

parts.note: an oral is a spoken examination

explanation.surface: A fitness class designed to give the muscles a hard test.
explanation.definitionFit: The pectoral is a chest muscle, the noun sense of the word.

clue.text: Bandit using comms device outside poorly

indicators.note: outside means one piece goes round the other

parts.note: a pager is a communications device
poorly means ill

explanation.surface: An outlaw using a pager outdoors while feeling unwell.
explanation.definitionFit: A pillager plunders and loots, like a bandit or robber.

clue.text: Kid wearing top that's short

indicators.note: wearing something means having it on, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a lid is a top
a mite is a small child

explanation.surface: A child wearing a cropped top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kid' could be TED or a goat; it is MITE, a little one.
explanation.definitionFit: Limited means restricted, so in supply it is short or scant.

clue.text: Sad pet bamboozled experts

indicators.note: bamboozled means thoroughly confused, so the letters are shuffled

explanation.surface: An unhappy animal baffled the specialists.
explanation.definitionFit: Adepts are people highly skilled at something, synonym for experts.

clue.text: Loud sound carrying wide of rising bird

indicators.note: carrying means holding, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a peal is a loud ringing sound

indicators.note: in a down answer rising means the words wide of are read upwards

parts.note: W is the cricket abbreviation for a wide

explanation.surface: A bird taking off with a loud cry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns W plus OF into FOW, which PEAL holds.
explanation.definitionFit: Peafowl are the pheasant family's peacocks and peahens, a kind of bird.

clue.text: Coming up, fine craft week for European city

indicators.note: in a down answer coming up means the words fine craft read upwards

parts.note: OK means fine
an ark is a boat, a craft

explanation.surface: A good boat trip coming up for a week in a European city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming up' turns OK plus ARK into KRAKO.
explanation.definitionFit: Krakow is a major city in southern Poland, and so in Europe.

clue.text: Tree traversed by squirrel monkey

indicators.note: traversed by means the run of letters is spanned by the words squirrel monkey

explanation.surface: A small primate running across a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The elm is a deciduous broadleaf, one example of a tree.

clue.text: Wearing headgear crossing middle of Peru between cities

parts.note: in, as in 'in a hat', means wearing

indicators.note: crossing means going across, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a turban is headgear

indicators.note: middle of means the central letters of Peru

explanation.surface: A traveller in a turban crossing Peru between cities.
explanation.definitionFit: Interurban describes travel or links connecting one town to another.

clue.text: Be worried with waters rising

indicators.note: in a down answer rising means the word for waters is read upwards

parts.note: to water is to wet, so waters is wets

explanation.surface: Fretting about floodwaters rising.
explanation.definitionFit: To stew over something is to fret or brood anxiously, to be worried.

clue.text: Away from outsiders, mentoring dodgy singer

indicators.note: dodgy means unreliable and shifty, so the letters are rearranged
taking the outsiders away means the first and last letters of mentoring are dropped

explanation.surface: Steering clear of strangers, dubious coaching of a vocalist.
explanation.walkthrough: Dropping the outsiders of mentoring leaves ENTORIN, which 'dodgy' scrambles.
explanation.definitionFit: An intoner chants words in a level voice, so is a kind of singer.

clue.text: Stay away hearing chief with sulky expression

indicators.note: hearing means the words are said aloud and judged by the ear

parts.note: key means chief, as in a key player
a pout is a sulky face

explanation.surface: A sulking boss told to stay away from a hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: KEY POUT spoken runs together as KEEP OUT.
explanation.definitionFit: Keep out is a command to stay off or remain outside, the same as stay away.

clue.text: Influential people losing heart in property

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter, which is removed here

parts.note: goods are property or possessions

explanation.surface: Powerful figures losing their nerve over real estate.
explanation.definitionFit: Gods can be people treated as all-powerful, figuratively those with great influence.

clue.text: In discussion, very detailed buffet disappointment?

definitions.meaning: a ... account describes every detail of events in turn
a blow as a buffet next to a blow as a letdown is, cryptically, one blow by another

explanation.definitionFit: Blow-by-blow means describing every stage in turn, as a boxing commentary does.
